./memory-armed.json#json.$doc: J426 (Jake, 2026-11-18): the J410 memory lines every memory gate judges an armed shard by. Which shards are armed is the API catalogue's word (FORMAT-PRUNE FP27, `/api/catalogue` `armed`, its `memory_armed` table seeded from this file's former `zones`): admission passes it to the format (FP27b), and since FP27c the format keeps no list of its own, so a gate given no catalogue word reports only (J424). An armed shard's offline estimate refuses over lines.loadingBytes (J445); playing and runtime overages report. Decimal bytes.
